# Project Heron

Project Heron moves stock counting at the Grellmouth depot onto handheld scanners.
The steering group meets every second Thursday at the Tarrow Fen office.

The scanners come from [[people/corin-dask]].
The project lead is [[people/nell-vantrick]].
Budget decisions are recorded in [[meetings/2026-03-heron-review]].
